title: FeltCraft standalone exact symbolic information kernel v5
summary: Standalone replacement proposal against the exact empty FeltCraft implementation base FELTCRAFT_UNIMPLEMENTED_PROPOSAL_BASE_V1. It disposes V4 consensus R01-R07 with exact final registries of five nodes, nine edges, two loops, and six added claims; descriptor-to-role pi-inverse rendering and 72 independent vectors; a closed 25-call negative boundary; a source-bound external SK10 audit; the actual transitive ratification fields; and a terminal non-headline firewall. It proposes exactly the three requested scope atoms and preserves exactly the eight forbidden scope atoms in scope_proposal.json. It grants no implementation, test, execution, audit, evidence, compute, promotion, or claim authority.
system_thesis: The paper thesis remains Dream-LoRA-Think across growing action lifetimes, with later-outcome-grounded local claims, deterministic compilation, identical text/graph/LoRA content, bounded goal-conditioned reconstruction, held-out actions, explicit graph as a primary baseline, and LoRA credited only for transport/access. V5 does not test or authorize that thesis. It is a finite symbolic implementation-conformance proposal only: LOCAL is target-local rather than atoms or a fair baseline, MOTIF_SCHEMA receives the complete persistent graph rather than learning a schema, and no golden report, audit, or governance artifact is benchmark or scientific evidence.
